fusions.name: Recited Verses
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts of arcana in a narrow spread, each dealing 6 damage. You hold 3 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Cut Short
fusions.desc: A cutting blow that deals 14 arcane damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Say It Twice
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Form
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
